summary.diagnosis:
*Sep 25→Oct 1 vs Sep 18→Sep 24* · Revenue +47% (1,020,656 vs 692,539 EGP) · Spend +16% · ROAS 5.77 (+27%).
   • CPC: 2.47 → 2.58 EGP (+4%, ~flat)
   • CVR: 0.9% → 1.16% (+29%, up (good))
   • AOV: 1,246 → 1,285 EGP (+3%, ~flat)
   *Who moved it:* *CVR 77%* of the move (helped, +229,156 EGP)  ·  *CPC 13%* of the move (hurt, -7,545 EGP)  ·  *AOV 9%* of the move (helped, +30,966 EGP).
   *Read:* *CVR* rose +29%, the biggest of the three.
     Worth about *229,156 EGP of revenue at the same clicks*.
     That drove ROAS +27%.
     Revenue +47% because spend +16%.
   *Deeper:* biggest single mover was *all products retention*, its CVR went 1.87%→2.33% on 17,409 EGP spend (~13% of the swing).
